code_commit_rule: BRIEF_46 G.2: a P9.1 run's code commit is its session's -- the session whose window, from its token line's stamp to the next session's of any stage, holds the run's started_unix -- as that token line names it, beside the run tree the driver checked is clean and detached at that commit. S.2 (Q20): the evaluation's code commit is the one commit every evaluate session's token line names, and the D4RL re-run's is its d4rl session's. A checkpoint's runtime.git_commit, and a route (i) file's, is the main tree's HEAD when the file was written, never the code's commit, and is not reported as one.

mix50.concordance_rule: for each of the six arm pairs, the predicted direction is the sign of the registered 40,000-step paired point difference (left - right) and the 100,000-step paired interval is judged by P5.2c's rule against it: HELD = concordant and resolved, FAILED = reversed and resolved, NOT RESOLVED otherwise (also where the 40,000-step difference is an exact tie, which predicts no order); the ordering's verdict is P5.2c's conjunction over the pairs
mix50.difference_rule: per arm, 100,000 - 40,000 steps, paired per draw across the five seeds (A27(g)); no direction is predicted, so the reading is the interval's side of zero
